description: Six-panel TEM figure of the TD sample deformed to 15% engineering strain, comparing the deformation modes of austenite, δ-ferrite and α-ferrite. (a1) is a bright-field (BF) image (500 nm scale bar) of a grain labelled γ showing dense parallel planar slip traces; a red dashed inset labelled "SFs" with red arrows magnifies stacking faults, and a bottom-right SAED inset is indexed to FCC with spots (-1-11), (-200), (-11-1), Z=[011]. (a2) is an HR-TEM image (2 nm scale bar) from a local region of that austenite grain showing SF lattice-fringe detail, with yellow and green dashed lines and layers labelled A, B, C, plus the same FCC Z=[011] diffraction inset. (b1) (2 µm scale bar) shows a δ-ferrite grain labelled δ, with red arrows and the red annotation "High-density dislocation wall"; its SAED inset is BCC-type with (01-1), (101), (110), Z=[-111]. (c1) (200 nm scale bar) shows an α-ferrite grain labelled α with a BCC SAED inset at the same zone axis. (b2) (200 nm) and (c2) (100 nm) are BF images of dislocation tangles in the δ and α ferrite grains, each annotated with red arrows and a two-beam SAED inset marked g=110. The figure demonstrates planar slip with dense stacking faults in austenite versus dislocation-tangle/cross-slip behaviour in both ferrite phases, explained by their different stacking-fault energy.

observations.observation: Panel (a1) is a bright-field TEM image (500 nm scale bar) of a grain labelled γ showing dense planar slip traces and stacking faults, magnified in a red dashed inset annotated 'SFs' with red arrows.
The SAED inset in (a1) and (a2) is indexed to FCC with reflections (-1-11), (-200) and (-11-1) at zone axis Z=[011].
Panel (a2) is an HR-TEM image with a 2 nm scale bar showing lattice-fringe detail of the stacking faults, with yellow and green dashed lines and layers labelled A, B, C in the enlarged inset.
Panel (b1) is a BF image (2 µm scale bar) of a δ-ferrite grain annotated 'High-density dislocation wall' with red arrows, and a red dashed box indicating the region shown in (b2).
The SAED inset of the δ-ferrite grain shows reflections (01-1), (101), (110) at zone axis Z=[-111], consistent with a body-centred cubic phase.
Panel (c1) is a BF image (200 nm scale bar) of an α-ferrite grain labelled α, with a BCC SAED inset showing (01-1), (101), (110) at Z=[-111] and a dashed box marking the region of (c2).
Panels (b2) (200 nm scale bar) and (c2) (100 nm scale bar) both show red arrows pointing to 'Dislocation tangles' inside the δ- and α-ferrite grains respectively.
The diffraction insets of (b2) and (c2) are two-beam patterns labelled g=110 with a white arrow marking the g vector.
The caption states this is a TEM observation of the deformation behaviour within austenite, α-ferrite and δ-ferrite for the TD sample at engineering strain 15%.

The caption states that the diffraction patterns in (b1-b2) and (c1-c2) were taken from a two-beam condition (g vector <110>) and reveal dislocation tangles in both α and δ ferrite, indicating dislocation cross-slip.
The citing text states that for some other austenite grains α'-martensite has not yet formed (Fig. 7(a1)), and that dislocation planar slip and dense stacking faults are observed in these grains.

The citing text explains the difference in deformation mode between austenite and ferrite by their different stacking-fault energy, austenite having the lower SFE which favours planar slip and strain-induced martensite.
Nothing in the panels quantifies defect density or fault spacing; the defect features are identified only by red arrows and text annotations.

subfigures.description: BF TEM image with a 500 nm scale bar of an austenite grain labelled γ in red, showing dense parallel planar slip bands. A red dashed inset at top right labelled 'SFs' magnifies stacking faults pointed out by three red arrows; a red dashed square at the bottom marks the region of the SAED inset.

BF TEM image with a 2 µm scale bar of a δ-ferrite grain labelled δ (red symbol). Red text reads 'High-density dislocation wall' with red arrows, one pointing to the wall and two pointing to nearby features; a red dashed box labelled b2 marks the region magnified in panel (b2).
BF TEM image with a 200 nm scale bar of an α-ferrite grain labelled α in red, bounded by dark curved boundaries; a red dashed box labelled c2 marks the region magnified in (c2).

HR-TEM image (BF) with a 2 nm scale bar taken from a local region of the austenite grain, showing lattice-fringe contrast; a red-outlined enlarged inset highlights fringe layers crossed by yellow and green dashed lines with red letters A, B, C labelling individual lattice planes/fault layers.

BF TEM image with a 200 nm scale bar showing a heavily deformed region with red text 'Dislocation tangles' and five red arrows pointing to tangled dislocation configurations; dark bands and a possibly deformation-twinned lamellar contrast appear in the upper right.
BF TEM image with a 100 nm scale bar with red text 'Dislocation tangles' and red arrows pointing to dense dislocation tangles and dipolar/wall-like arrangements within the α-ferrite grain.
Selected-area diffraction pattern indexed FCC with spots labelled (-1-11), (-200), (-11-1) and zone axis Z=[011], shown in both (a1) and (a2).
Selected-area diffraction pattern with spots labelled (01-1), (101), (110) and zone axis Z=[-111]; the phase label in the corner is small and partially legible (reads as BCC/BCG).
Selected-area diffraction pattern labelled BCC with spots (01-1), (101), (110) and zone axis Z=[-111].
Two-beam diffraction patterns labelled 'g=110' with a white arrow indicating the g vector (arrow points toward the intense transmitted/reflection spots).
